column2: [intro]

But one day, he understood that everything was just a game
And that context was the key to living better
In this wacky world, it's a matter of context
Everything becomes funny and everything becomes grotesque
Laughter is our ally, even when everything gets complex
Life is much funnier when we change perspective
In an absurd world, nothing is really serious
A simple misunderstanding can become wonderful
So let's open our eyes, change our point of view
And transform life into a fabulous circus
